global_caption: The video contains five shots. It is a realistic, low-saturation a cappella performance filmed indoors in a museum, presented in a reserved, nostalgic neutral palette of warm and cool tones. The camera movement starts slow, stabilizes, then slightly accelerates with the harmonic progression. Lighting remains consistent with natural side light from corridors and soft ceiling illumination within the museum. Only Chinese The emotional tone remains consistently gentle and reflective throughout.

A shallow-blurred doorframe passes in the foreground, while the background reveals a quiet, open entrance hall. Low-saturation stone and glass reflections create a calm, controlled atmosphere. Natural side light sweeps across their shoulders and cheeks, gently moving fabric edges. shot2: Shot 2 hard cuts from the previous shot to a medium eye-level push-in, transitioning to the central atrium. Composition centers on one elderly woman standing in the middle, with the other five arranged semi-circularly behind and to the sides. Background features tall columns and soft daylight. Shallow depth of field clearly separates the subjects from the architecture. The camera slowly pushes along the central axis to a chest-level close-up, stopping exactly as the first phrase’s final note stretches.
shot3: Shot 3 hard cuts on the final note to a near-close eye-level shot beside an exhibit case. The glass case in the foreground reflects blurred figures, while authentic artifacts displayed to the side and rear add depth. Soft top light creates subtle reflections on glass surfaces—non-distracting yet enhancing spatial texture. As one finishes, her lips haven’t fully closed before the next naturally takes over. Chest vibrations and taps align tightly with the subtle foot shuffling below.
shot4: The six elderly women form a small, stable group within geometric floor patterns. The dome and circular railings create a strong centralized composition. Foreground shows blurred railing at the edge of the hall, while background extends upward into vast interior space.
shot5: Shot 5 transitions via fade-in/fade-out to a close-up of the exit steps. Low-angle slight tilt-up focuses on one elderly woman’s profile, slightly parted lips, and wind brushing past the step edge. Other members appear softly blurred in the background, creating a shift from group imagery to individual resonance. Evening-like natural side light glides across her cheek and collar, while the brighter sky outside the glass door forms a clean backdrop. The final note disperses like air carried off.
